A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same locality study of concept bottleneck models. Their readable text, figures, table, equations, and appendices support reliable matching. The missing abstract text in v3 is a document omission confirmed visually, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: v2 reports original experiments on synthetic shapes, CUB, and COCO, including locality measurements, mitigation experiments, and appendix analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds results for label-free CBMs and models incorporating residual connections.

M1.justification: The proposed locality leakage, masking, and intervention measurements retain the same procedures. Label-free CBMs and residual connections are additional evaluated alternatives, rather than changes to the proposed methodology.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic shape tasks, noisy synthetic variants, CUB, and COCO. The added evaluations use existing coverage; restricting the label-free comparison to shared CUB concept groups is a protocol choice.

E2.justification: Figure 4 adds Label-Free CBMs to the CUB comparison alongside the retained baseline, two-step, and correlation methods. Appendix P additionally evaluates residual connections following Havasi et al. Existing CEM, ProbCBM, and other comparisons remain.

E3.justification: The new label-free masking comparison uses only concept groups shared between CUB and the Label-Free concept list. The residual experiment evaluates models of depths 3–7 with an additional unsupervised concept. Previously stated settings for retained experiments remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix P and Figure 20 add an analysis of whether residual connections alleviate locality leakage across model depths. Existing noise, pruning, adversarial-training, masking, width/depth, and receptive-field analyses are retained under revised appendix lettering.

E5.justification: Both versions retain three-seed reporting, five locality-leakage trials, existing uncertainty displays, and the epoch-analysis nonsignificance statement. v3's new checklist asserts appropriate significance testing without identifying tests or comparisons, leaving unclear whether statistical procedures changed or were merely summarized.

E6.justification: v3 adds label-free CUB results showing small responses to both relevant and irrelevant masking. Figure 20 adds residual-model results, including locality leakage of 1 at depth 7 despite perfect accuracy. Existing plotted results and all Table 1 values are retained.

T1.justification: The locality definitions, mathematical metrics, Theorem 5.1 error bound, and supporting lemmas and proof are unchanged. The theory appendix moves from Q to S through renumbering.

C1.justification: The introduction and conclusion retain the same central claims: CBMs can violate locality, tested mitigations fail to resolve this generally, and correlated concepts permit accurate but unfaithful predictors. The added experiments support these retained claims despite the omission of the abstract.

C2.justification: v3 interprets the label-free masking results as evidence of reliance on features outside concept localities. It also discusses residual connections' failure and explicitly leaves their depth-6 leakage dip unexplained. Existing limitations concerning distribution shifts and unavailable counterfactuals remain.

D1.justification: v2 promises code, models, and datasets after review; v3 supplies a specific code-repository link and adds a reproducibility checklist with code/data release assurances. Existing dataset construction, hyperparameters, training budgets, hardware, and computational-cost descriptions are retained.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations to Pham, Raman, Marconato, and Furby works from 2024, including a distinction from Furby's focus on inaccurate labelling. It removes the Smilkov and Sundararajan saliency-method references. The principal research positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: Most prose and section order are retained, with localized compression and explanatory rewrites and removal of subsection numbering. v3 omits the abstract body and Broader Impacts paragraph, adds acknowledgements and a reproducibility checklist, and renumbers the appendices.

P2.justification: The manuscript changes throughout from single-column to two-column layout, extensively resizing and relocating existing displays. Figure 4 adds a label-free series and stacks its CUB/COCO panels; Figure 11 also changes panel arrangement. Figure 20 is newly added.

improvement.justification: The label-free and residual-connection experiments test additional plausible remedies, strengthening support for the mitigation findings, while the repository link improves access information. However, v3 removes the entire abstract, leaving its heading empty and losing the paper's concise overview. With most scientific content unchanged, these limited evidential gains and the clear presentation loss leave the net quality direction uncertain.
